items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I went to France with Joe Williams... I’ve played with Joe many times.

ctx.x: Did you ever have occasion to play behind Joe Williams and some of the other singers?

Yeah, I went to France with Joe Williams, I forget how long ago, oh, five years ago, where he took a small group, two horns and a rhythm section to do a festival in southern France. I’ve played with Joe many times. But not for long periods of time or anything like that, just like being on the same venue.
What’s in the future for you right now?
